name: CrossMux
summary: Open-source e-reader firmware with an apps hub, tools, games, and multilingual support.
description: Install the CrossMux firmware package prepared for reTerminal Sticky. CrossMux combines an e-reader with an apps hub of practical tools and mini-games.

compatibility.notes: Version 1.6.0 is tested on reTerminal Sticky production hardware.

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: The standard option writes the complete four-part CrossMux package.
